run_download_support_docs: run the CLI to download and extract Common Crawl WET files for a given slice number
run_download_support_docs_with_subreddit: run the CLI with custom subreddit names to gather support documents for multiple subreddits
run_download_support_docs_resume: run the CLI with a slice number to resume processing from a saved checkpoint
review_main: review the main function that orchestrates WET file downloading, parsing, and article extraction
refactor_main: refactor the main function to use Python os.makedirs instead of subprocess mkdir calls
